docs.summary: Provides methods to register, organize, and clear a hierarchical menu system built from AppMenuItem nodes.
The top-level menu items registered in the system.

members.name: Register
members.signature: public static void Register(string path, Action onClick, bool enabled = true, Func<bool>? isChecked = null, Func<bool>? isEnabled = null, Func<string>? dynamicLabel = null, string icon = "")

docs.summary: Registers a menu item at the specified slash-delimited path. Creates intermediate nodes as needed. If the path already exists, updates its properties with the provided values.
Adds a visual separator to the sub-menu at the specified parent path. Does nothing if the parent path does not exist.

members.name: RegisterBranchIcon
members.signature: public static void RegisterBranchIcon(string path, string icon)

docs.summary: Sets the icon on the menu item at the specified path. Does nothing if the path does not exist or the icon is null or empty.
